message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Inventory Growth Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly percentage changes in inventory (from Compustat) over the past 3 years.", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile inventory growth may face greater uncertainty or operational inefficiency, which could be priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Debt Issuance Acceleration", "construction": "Change in short-term debt (Compustat: DLCQ) over the past year divided by total assets, minus the same change in the prior year.", "rationale": "A rapid acceleration in short-term borrowing may signal financial distress or aggressive expansion, potentially leading to higher risk premia.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "R&D expense (Compustat: XRD) over the past year divided by the sum of R&D expense and capital expenditures (CAPX) over the same period.", "rationale": "Firms investing more in R&D relative to physical capital may be riskier or have more growth opportunities, which could be rewarded.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Frequency", "construction": "Number of quarters in the past 5 years where a firm omitted a regular dividend payment, divided by the number of expected payments.", "rationale": "Frequent dividend omissions may indicate financial instability, which could be associated with higher expected returns as compensation for risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Operating Lease Intensity", "construction": "Estimated annual operating lease expense (from footnotes) divided by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with higher off-balance-sheet leverage via operating leases may be riskier and thus command higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Exposure", "construction": "Percentage of sales to the largest customer (from 10-K disclosures) in the most recent fiscal year.", "rationale": "High customer concentration increases business risk, which may be compensated by higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Application Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in the number of patent applications filed (from USPTO data) by the firm.", "rationale": "Rapid growth in patent applications may signal innovation and future growth potential, possibly leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Ratio", "construction": "Deferred tax assets (Compustat: TXDB) divided by total assets.", "rationale": "Large deferred tax assets may indicate aggressive accounting or past losses, which could be associated with higher risk and returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Payment Stretch", "construction": "Change in accounts payable days (accounts payable / cost of goods sold * 365) over the past year.", "rationale": "Firms stretching payments to suppliers may be facing liquidity issues, which could be priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "CEO Tenure Change", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if the CEO has changed in the past 12 months, 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Recent CEO turnover may signal uncertainty or transition risk, potentially leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
